claims: Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer are the sons of former NBA All-Star Carlos Boozer.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer committed to Duke in October 2024.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer committed to Duke over offers from Miami, Florida, and Kentucky.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer were born in 2007.
Carlos Boozer played for the Chicago Bulls.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer were members of the AAU team NightRydas Elite.
Cayden Boozer stepped into starting roles during critical moments like the ACC Tournament.
Carlos Boozer is a 13-year NBA veteran.
Carlos Boozer was a 2001 Duke national champion.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer were conceived with the hope that their stem cells would save their older brother Carmani from sickle cell disease.
